mapper.select: SELECT ifnull(dic.area,0) as area,net.time time,sum(net.count)/1024/1024 count FROM ( select RECV_TIME time,sum(INOCTETS+OUTOCTETS) count,NODE_IP ip from traffic_netflow_port_info GROUP BY RECV_TIME,ip HAVING RECV_TIME>= #{start} and RECV_TIME< #{end} ) net LEFT JOIN (SELECT entrance_id area,manager_ip ip from ntc_device_info) dic on net.ip = dic.ip GROUP BY area,net.time
